name: com.kott.configs
description: Typed game config data for Unity. Author templates as ScriptableObjects (and JSON files) with typed cross-references, validate and bake them per config set, publish them to files or Unity Remote Config, and load them at runtime from layered sources with typed lookups.

samples.description: A bestiary from one config set: template assets and a JSON file, subtypes, template and Addressables asset references, an enum mapping, and layered loaders with an override file you can edit while playing. Works without Scopes; needs uGUI.
